basic_info.description: 2450-2456 Van Ness Avenue is a five (5) unit mixed-use building located steps from Union  Street. Now priced at $1,950,000 (7.32% Cap, 9.73 GRM assuming occupied commercial space). With 5,644 sq ft of rentable space, the units include three 1-bedroom,1-bath units,1-bath unit, one 3-bedroom,1 bath unit, and one commercial space that is approximately 2,000 sq/ft. The backyard offers a spacious, quite garden. The commercial space could be a useful home to an owner-user who could occupy the entire ground-floor or split the space into two side-by-side storefronts.
